summary: This work makes several parts of the DOM—the browser’s model of a page—more efficient and reliable, including updates to text, selections, and shadow DOM. It also improves Speculation Rules prefetching, which can load likely next pages in advance, and adds per-document Trusted Types telemetry to help track websites’ progress toward safer handling of page content. Redirect checks and tracking-protection helpers further tighten how pages and network requests are handled.
